audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is tagged EVEN at 6/10 while the win rate is 48.13% over 5849 games — the largest sample in this slice and a losing one. I have not changed diff or diffRating because the difference is small and the tag is a judgement call, but the level chart built on top of it was wrong in five of seven rows and is corrected below.
audit.why: Below 50% with a 9/10 enemy carry threat, the honest framing is a lane Sion wins early and loses on the scaling.
audit.corrected: Chart corrected; diff/diffRating left for the user to rule on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows were wrong. Level 2 was scored to Sion though whys[1] says extended level-2 fights bleed your HP. Levels 4-5 were Skill though whys[3] says his Q dash lets him trade and disengage before your charge completes. Level 6 was Skill though whys[4], spikes[1] and mid call R 'your strongest 6 spike in this matchup'. First item was Sion though whys[5] and spikes[2] say Kraken Slayer starts punishing your HP stack there. 2+ items was Sion though whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say never 1v1 him at that stage.
audit.why: Every one of those rows told the user the opposite of the paragraph underneath it, and the two that matter most — first item and two items — told a losing Sion he was winning.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Skill, Sion, Yone, Sion, Skill, Yone in both layers, matching the packet, with ratings inverted.
sources: existing whys[1], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[1..3], mid, late

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound was described only as 'he snaps back'. Riot's text says the retraction REPEATS a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit — a delayed second damage instance the page never warned about — and the ability is 22s at rank 1, falling to 10s. Spirit Cleave was called a burst but never identified as a shield whose cooldown shortens with his attack speed.
audit.why: Players survive the spirit phase and then die to the retraction damage they were never told existed. And a shield that scales down from 14s decides who wins the second half of every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Retraction damage and the 22s timer written into whys[2] and dosFull[0].d; Spirit Cleave's shield and scaling cooldown into whys[1].

edits.before: W-shield eats his Q3-W cleave burst in a short trade, but his Q cooldown resets fast enough that extended fights at level 2 bleed your HP — trade short and recall ahead.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him while it damages you, and its 14s cooldown shortens as his attack speed grows — his shield outlasts yours in a long trade, so take one exchange only.

edits.before: Soul Unbound commits him to a location until retraction — a charged Q stun during that window pins him in place, and E armor-shred turns the punish into a real HP lead.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and leaves his body behind — stun the body with a charged Q before the spirit snaps back, and the E shred turns that punish into a real HP lead.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Q-stun in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Retraction repeats part of his spirit damage — stun before it lands or wait out the 22s.

edits.before: Use Soul Unbound (E) to poke in, apply damage, and retract before your charged Q telegraph completes
edits.after: Poke with Soul Unbound and retract before your Q releases — the snapback repeats his spirit damage

notes: The packet suspectName 'Use Soul Unbound' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Soul Unbound is the correct name for Yone's E. QUESTION FOR THE USER is recorded separately: whether diff should move from EVEN given the 48.13% win rate. Sion Q's listed range of 10000 is a data artifact and was not used.
